sn.s: La pregunta llega un domingo, sin aviso.
sn.e: The question comes one Sunday, with no warning.

sn.s: Estamos almorzando en la casa de doña Elena.
sn.e: We are having lunch at doña Elena's house.

sn.s: Están los dos hermanos y una tía.
sn.e: The two brothers and an aunt are there.

sn.s: Estamos hablando de nada.
sn.e: We are talking about nothing.

sn.s: Y doña Elena baja el tenedor.
sn.e: And doña Elena puts down her fork.

sn.s: "¿Y usted qué piensa hacer?", pregunta ella.
sn.e: "And what are you planning to do?" she asks.

sn.s: La mesa entera se queda callada.
sn.e: The whole table goes quiet.

sn.s: Todos siguen comiendo como si nada.
sn.e: Everybody carries on eating as if nothing.

sn.s: Pero nadie está masticando.
sn.e: But nobody is chewing.

sn.s: Yo sé exactamente lo que me está preguntando.
sn.e: I know exactly what she is asking me.

sn.s: Me está preguntando por su hija.
sn.e: She is asking me about her daughter.

sn.s: Y la pregunta es delante de todos a propósito.
sn.e: And the question is in front of everybody on purpose.

sn.s: Si fuera a solas, sería una conversación.
sn.e: If it were alone, it would be a conversation.

sn.s: Delante de todos, es un compromiso.
sn.e: In front of everybody, it is a commitment.

sn.s: Lo que yo diga aquí van a oírlo cinco personas.
sn.e: What I say here five people are going to hear.

sn.s: Y esas cinco personas se lo cuentan a veinte.
sn.e: And those five people tell twenty.

sn.s: Roberto me había avisado que esto venía.
sn.e: Roberto had warned me this was coming.

sn.s: "Cuando te lo pregunten, no dudés", me dijo.
sn.e: "When they ask you, don't hesitate," he said.

sn.s: "Dudar es peor que contestar mal."
sn.e: "Hesitating is worse than answering wrong."

sn.s: Entonces no dudo.
sn.e: So I do not hesitate.

sn.s: "Yo estoy en serio con ella", digo yo.
sn.e: "I'm serious about her," I say.

sn.s: Doña Elena no cambia la cara.
sn.e: Doña Elena does not change her face.

sn.s: "¿Y piensa quedarse en el país?"
sn.e: "And are you planning to stay in the country?"

sn.s: Esa es la segunda pregunta y la más difícil.
sn.e: That is the second question and the hardest.

sn.s: Porque la respuesta honesta es que no sé.
sn.e: Because the honest answer is that I do not know.

sn.s: Y aquí no sé suena a no.
sn.e: And here I do not know sounds like no.

sn.s: Contesto lo único que puedo contestar.
sn.e: I answer the only thing I can answer.

sn.s: "No tengo planes de irme", digo yo.
sn.e: "I have no plans to leave," I say.

sn.s: "Y si algún día me voy, no me voy solo."
sn.e: "And if I ever do go, I won't go alone."

sn.s: Eso último no lo tenía pensado.
sn.e: That last part I had not planned.

sn.s: Me salió solo.
sn.e: It came out on its own.

sn.s: Lucía deja el vaso en la mesa muy despacio.
sn.e: Lucía sets her glass down very slowly.

sn.s: Doña Elena me mira unos segundos.
sn.e: Doña Elena looks at me for a few seconds.

sn.s: Después agarra el tenedor otra vez.
sn.e: Then she picks up her fork again.

sn.s: "Está bien", dice ella.
sn.e: "All right," she says.

sn.s: Y la mesa vuelve a hablar de nada.
sn.e: And the table goes back to talking about nothing.

sn.s: Julio empieza a contar algo del béisbol.
sn.e: Julio starts telling something about the baseball.

sn.s: Y ya está, se acabó, se pasó.
sn.e: And that is it, it is over, it has passed.

sn.s: Todo eso duró cuarenta segundos.
sn.e: All of that lasted forty seconds.

sn.s: Caminando de vuelta le pregunto a Lucía.
sn.e: Walking back I ask Lucía.

sn.s: "¿Eso estuvo bien?", pregunto yo.
sn.e: "Was that all right?" I ask.

sn.s: Ella no me contesta enseguida.
sn.e: She does not answer straight away.

sn.s: "Lo de irte acompañado", dice ella al final.
sn.e: "The bit about not going alone," she says finally.

sn.s: "¿Eso lo dijiste por decir?"
sn.e: "Did you say that just to say it?"

sn.s: "No", digo yo.
sn.e: "No," I say.

sn.s: Y ella no dice nada por dos cuadras enteras.
sn.e: And she says nothing for two whole blocks.
